tasks.Encourage: Encouraging children can make them more cooperative during nap time.
tasks.Fear: Instilling fear is not recommended as it may cause anxiety in children.
tasks.Lower Expectations: Lowering expectations before nap time might lead to less resistance from children.
tasks.Tell Story: Telling a story before nap time can engage children and make them more willing to rest.
tasks.Time Test: Timing the activities leading up to nap time can help manage the transition smoothly.

answer: What does a kindergarten teacher do before nap time? Answer Choices: (a) lower expectations (b) encourage (c) fear (d) time test (e) tell story
